stories.title: Consent Data Schema and Persistence Model
stories.description: Define and implement MongoDB schema and data contracts for consent records, including tier level, timestamps, user identifiers, and audit metadata. Ensure compatibility with lead capture and debug logging systems.

stories.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Exposure
stories.description: Expose consent workflow through FastAPI endpoints and integrate with tool_router for controlled invocation. Support actions such as capturing consent, upgrading tiers, and retrieving consent state for downstream services.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier transitions, PHI protection enforcement, de-identification behavior, and API contract compliance. Include negative tests for invalid transitions and missing consent.
